refresh_policy.notes: Treat SoilGrids as a global soil-property baseline and API-doc snapshot rather than as a local live monitoring feed.

use_guidance.primary_role: Use for soil baseline support on land, agriculture, and soil-moisture stress nodes.
use_guidance.caution: SoilGrids is a modeled global soil-property surface and documentation family, not a real-time field sensor network.

overview.title: SoilGrids250m 2.0
overview.description: SoilGrids250m 2.0 - A system for digital soil mapping based on global compilation of soil profile data and environmental layers

service_caveats: SoilGrids is a global modeled soil baseline, not a local ground-truth monitoring service.
The API docs endpoint returned 504 Gateway Time-out during refresh, so docs availability should be treated as intermittent.
Best fit is soil-property grounding and agricultural/land-system context.
Use alongside hydrology and food-system layers, not as a standalone drought or crop-loss feed.
supported_questions: Which land and agriculture nodes need a defensible global soil baseline?
Where should TULIP use soil-property context rather than only hydrology framing?
Which soil-stress nodes need official ISRIC grounding?
